text:
Got a call from the night shift guy at Kerrobert station. At 06:50 he flagged a relief valve
venting sweet gas on the ops radio. Said it was part of the planned maintenance work. Meter
showed about 850 m³ gone, rate pegged at 2 kg/s. Whole thing inside the fence, no alarms
sounding, valve looked like it was working like it's supposed to. Just wanted us to know
before we came in. No drama, just routine.
